data.overview: A highly calculated gubernatorial candidate finds his meticulously engineered political campaign and public persona thrown into absolute disarray when a maternal curse renders him entirely incapable of deception, forcing him to navigate the political arena with unfiltered, absolute honesty.

Pencitraan udah disiapin. Jonas Prakoso dan Sambodo udah siap banget jadi calon gubernur dan wakil gubernur idaman. Tapi kutukan nenek bikin Jonas GAK BISA BOHONG SAMA SEKALI!  Kepikiran apa, nyeplos. Di depan keluarga, timses, lawan politik, sampai rakyat.  Kalau mulut nggak punya rem, siap-siap semuanya kebongkar!
